list.name: product
list.label: Product
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, product_key AS __value FROM sampledw.dim_product ORDER BY name;

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.bucket AS time, p.name AS metric, sum(c.total_net_amount) AS value FROM sampledw.cagg_sales_daily c JOIN sampledw.dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE $__timeFilter(c.bucket) AND c.product_key IN ($product) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT p.category, sum(f.net_amount) AS revenue FROM sampledw.fact_sales f JOIN sampledw.dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE $__timeFilter(f.sale_time) AND f.product_key IN ($product) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', f.sale_time) AS time, sum(f.quantity) AS units FROM sampledw.fact_sales f WHERE $__timeFilter(f.sale_time) AND f.product_key IN ($product) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT p.sku, p.name, sum(c.total_quantity) AS units, sum(c.total_net_amount) AS revenue FROM sampledw.cagg_sales_daily c JOIN sampledw.dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE $__timeFilter(c.bucket) AND c.product_key IN ($product) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY revenue DESC;
